# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest version deployed from the `main` branch is actively maintained.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues.

Send a private report to `kumar.shiv.pms@gmail.com` with:

- A clear description of the vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce or a proof of concept.
- The affected URL, file, or workflow.
- The potential impact and any suggested mitigation.

Please allow reasonable time for investigation before public disclosure. Do not include passwords, access tokens, personal data, or other secrets in the report.

This site is static and does not intentionally collect credentials or process private user data. Issues involving third-party services, GitHub Pages, or Hugo dependencies should also be reported to the relevant upstream maintainers when appropriate.
